## Objective

Solve the electrostatic potential $\phi(x, y)$ inside a grounded rectangular conductive box with two interior charged plates held at $\pm 100\text{ V}$.

1. Implement Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, and SOR numerical relaxation schemes.
2. Measure the number of iterations required to reach an error tolerance $\epsilon = 10^{-6}$ as a function of grid size $N \in \{32, 64, 128\}$.
3. Compute the electric field $\mathbf{E} = -\boldsymbol{\nabla}\phi$ using 2nd-order central differences and plot field lines.
